newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW-Cookson sees profit growth in H2.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-Cookson sees profit growth in H2.

text.p: British electronic, ceramic and plastic materials company Cookson Group Plc said on Thursday it expected overall profit growth in the second half of the year.
"We feel confident that the overall results in the second half will certainly exceed those in the first half," said chief executive Richard Oster.
Growth will resume because results in the electronics division improve as the industry de-stocking process is over.
"We enter the second half with a very strong order book, we have new products coming to the market place and we see good prospects going forward," Oster told Reuters.

Cookson said earlier that full-year profits would be in line with market expectations. Oster added that consensus analysts' forecast for operating and pre-tax profit are 205 and 180 million pounds respectively.
Cookson reported flat first-half pre-tax profits of 85.4 million stg, coming in just above market estimates.
Oster said the results were better than expected as analysts had been too cautious on the electronics division recovery.
"They weren't sure the electronics division was going to recover and they wanted to wait and see," Oster.
The electronics division was still suffering from price pressure as the industry-wide recovery was still in its early stages, Cookson said. But Oster added he did not see the pressure deepening.
Oster will become chairman on October 1, taking over from Robert Malpas who will retire, while Oster will be replaced by Stephen Howard, who currently is joint group managing director.
Malpas said the transition would be "seamless" and there would not be any change in Cookson's strategy.
"We are very pleased that we are promoting from within the company and that immediately implies that there will be a clear continuity," Malpas said.
